categorisation: This gazette content involves the repeal and substitution of a specific regulation (Regulation No.: 7.7.2 (3) (c)) under the Sri Lanka Institute of Architects Law, which constitutes a legal/regulatory amendment. It does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) or fit other specialized categories like land, commercial, elections, etc. The core action is modifying the legal framework governing the professional institute.
